title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode19 Quartet's Starry Sky

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What did you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: First, I need to show you something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll need to come to Miku's world for this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's that place we were suddenly taken to before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is our SEKAI.
Follow me and I'll show you something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika... Have you been coming here since that one time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. We do our band practice here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... You all meet up here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, come this way. We're going to the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever seen the night sky like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It was the first time for me too.
And Saki, and Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you remember when we went to that park to watch that meteor shower?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We used to play there all the time, but at night it felt like a different place. Even just walking there was a bit like an adventure.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe that's why the stars seemed even brighter and more beautiful that night.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were talking about it the other day with Saki, and she mistook the Leonids for the Cancrids.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How could she? I told her so many times what that meteor shower was called...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At one point she started coming up with her own original names for constellations. Panda, Pigtails, and so on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... Yes, she did! Then Shiho joined in with doesn't that one look like a bass guitar?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really want all four of us in this band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And I want to see you smile more often.
I wish we could all laugh together again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, don't you want to still be friends with us?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. She thinks that's how she'll get everyone to like her.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line:
But I bet she believes she's such an angel.
We can all see through her phoney kindness.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't want to get between you and the friends you have now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't know? Really? You made Saki cry, you realize that, don't you?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish we could all laugh together again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's like Shiho said. I feel sorry for myself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I gave in to the pressure from my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I didn't want to be disliked.
It made me so scared...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I only ended up hurting those who cared about me the most.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all this, do you really want me back?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's what we all want more than anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We thought it would be best enjoyed with friends.
